QWEN_RAW_LM.note: The Decision Index 0.3 public index averages 37 benchmarks in five areas with fixed weights (knowledge 25.8%, language 25.8%, retrieval 20.0%, tools 18.3%, arts 10%). Inside an area, gold ★ benchmarks weigh 1.2 and the rest 1.0; the index is 100 x the weighted mean of the five areas. Each benchmark is chance-corrected first, (score - chance) / (1 - chance) clipped to 0-1, so 0 means random guessing and 100 means perfect. Every score is coverage-adjusted, so an unanswered or unsupported request counts as wrong. On the board this public index is 20% of the Full score; the rest comes from private tests run by the maintainers.
